files.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original playable protagonist design sheet for Unfinished Sketchbook, a somber atmospheric 2D side-scrolling metroidvania in a world made of paper strata, graphite, pencil wood and old roots. This is the SAME ONE character in three poses, not three different designs. Landscape 1536x1024 composition requested. Main left 55 percent: large clean full-body right-facing three-quarter idle pose. Upper right: smaller strict right-facing side-view idle. Lower right: smaller right-facing mid-run pose. Generous spacing, all feet and hands visible. No text, labels, panels, logos or UI. Plain muted dark charcoal background, no scenery. Character design LOCK: a very simple nameless unfinished drawn being, circular head about 45 percent of total height, compact upright rounded-rectangle torso, very short thin arms and legs like substantial single ink strokes with tiny rounded ends, exactly ONE small dark dot eye visible on the forward side of the head, NO mouth, nose, brows, hair, ears, horns, clothes, cape, scarf, armor, shoes, gloves, hat, weapon or accessories. No colored accents anywhere on the character. Chalk ivory #F0EEE6 body with restrained neutral warm-gray shading, clean soft ink-gray #25272C contour. Keep enough separation between head and torso to read clearly, no neck ornament. The character is mysterious and vulnerable with quiet determination, not a cheerful toy mascot. Slight forward weight and attentive head angle. Material/rendering: beautiful polished non-pixel 2D game illustration, tactile compressed-paper/chalk matte surface, a FEW broad gentle material irregularities, faint shallow paper depressions, subtle bevel-like shaded relief but not a 3D render or a plush toy, no photographic pores or grit. Preserve simple flat graphic silhouette and broad value shapes. The background game art uses broad rounded layered matter with medium painted relief; match that material family while making the protagonist simpler and much brighter. A few tiny intentional interruptions in the far contour can suggest incompleteness, but limbs and silhouette must remain readable. No scribbling, hatching, thin scratchy lines, jagged spikes, glitter, glow aura, bloom, shiny plastic, intricate realistic texture, photorealism, pixel art or dithering. Proportions fit a 96 by 176 pixel gameplay bounding box at 1080p; enlarged sheet is for inspecting the same design. Design must remain readable at 176px tall. Consistent anatomy, one eye and proportions in ALL three poses.

Use case: compositing. Make ONE presentation image showing the SAME approved protagonist from reference image 1 placed into the FOUR existing regional game environment previews supplied as images 2 through 5, plus a FIFTH transition preview blending the walnut wood of image 4 smoothly into the olive roots of image 5. The character sheet is an IDENTITY reference; images 2 through 5 are compositing targets, preserve their material textures, darkness, colors, side-scrolling orthographic perspective and foreground floor silhouettes closely. Output a square 1536x1536 presentation board with EXACTLY FIVE environment panels: paper cavern upper left, blue-gray graphite upper right, walnut wood middle left, olive roots middle right, a full-width wood-to-root transition across the bottom. Narrow plain charcoal gutters between panels. No text or captions. Keep the five environments identifiable and maintain the existing organic rough ground instead of drawing new scenic caves. Crop/reframe the provided views to these panels, preserving a usable walking floor. Add exactly ONE small full-body protagonist into EACH panel, feet firmly resting on the playable top edge, mostly near horizontal center, side view facing right. Use the same monochrome ivory paper character in all panels: circular oversized head, one small dark dot eye only, short rounded rectangular torso, simple short limbs, no nose, no mouth, no clothing, no accessories. Match image 1 precisely in silhouette and restrained paper relief. Reduce the hero to gameplay scale: about 16 to 19 percent of each panel's height, not a giant close-up. At the bottom transition panel keep the same absolute character height as the other panels. No duplicate figures within any panel. Hero is the lightest element, warm chalk-white #F0EEE6 with soft dark charcoal outline, no glow, no color tint changes between regions. Tiny subdued contact shadow, never a spotlight. Preserve the low-contrast matte layered rear walls and brighter irregular walkable terrain rims. This is a visual fit study for the game, not a new landscape painting. Non-pixel polished 2D game art. No UI, health bars, portals, fantasy armor, weapons, colored scarf, glitter, lens flare, exaggerated rimlight, photorealistic additions, perspective depth or grids.

notes: Same monochrome character across four zones and the wood/root transition.
Environment board is a generated concept composite, not an actual Unity screenshot.
